label: Some ordinary-role belief reason has force at its subject's actual preference
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: some subject, consideration and content p are such that the consideration is an attributed ordinary-role reason for believing p and has pro tanto force for that subject at the subject's actual supplied preference. The goal-relative rival grants this whenever an accuracy-valuing subject has favoring evidence. No preference independence, overriding duty or factivity is asserted.
